# Owner console (`@dos/console`)

The distributor owner, manager and accountant: masters (catalog, costs, retailers, prices, schemes), the approvals queue, orders, and later billing desk, registers and imports. Web today (Vite); becomes `frontend-apps/owner-app` (Expo web + Android + iOS) in the layout restructure.

Talks to the **Owner service** on port 3001 (`VITE_API_URL, default same-origin /api → :3001`). Runs on its own: start the service, then the app.

## Run

```bash
pnpm --filter @dos/owner-service dev   # :3001
pnpm --filter @dos/console dev         # http://localhost:5173 (proxies /api -> :3001)
```

## Screens

- Dashboard: API/DB status, tenant card
- Catalog: list/unlist variants, case size, MOQ, alias
- Purchase costs (owner/manager/accountant only)
- Retailers: list, add, credit terms
- Price lists & schemes, bargain queue
- Orders & approvals: queue, order drawer, confirm/cancel

## Endpoints this app uses

Full request/response samples for each are in `backend-services/owner-service/README.md`.

| Method | Path | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/health/ping` | Liveness + database reachability |
| GET | `/tenancy/me` | Current user, tenant and membership |
| GET | `/catalog/variants` | Search the global product master |
| GET | `/catalog/manufacturers` | Manufacturers with their brands |
| POST | `/catalog/proposals` | Propose a missing product; usable immediately |
| GET | `/tenant-catalog/products` | What this distributor sells (no cost) |
| POST | `/tenant-catalog/products` | List/unlist a variant and set order rules |
| GET | `/tenant-catalog/suppliers` | Suppliers of this distributor |
| POST | `/tenant-catalog/suppliers` | Create or update a supplier |
| GET | `/tenant-catalog/costs` | Purchase costs (owner/manager/accountant only) |
| POST | `/tenant-catalog/costs` | Set purchase cost (owner/manager/accountant only) |
| GET | `/retailers` | Retailers of this distributor (retailer role: only its own, without credit) |
| GET | `/retailers/{id}` | One retailer (retailer role: only its own, without credit) |
| POST | `/retailers` | Create or update a retailer; code is server-assigned |
| POST | `/retailers/{id}/credit` | Set tier and credit terms (owner/manager/accountant only) |
| POST | `/retailers/{id}/link` | Link the retailer to its global identity by phone |
| GET | `/beats` | Beats of this distributor |
| POST | `/beats` | Create or update a beat |
| POST | `/beats/{id}/assign` | Assign a salesperson to a beat for a date range |
| POST | `/visits` | Record a shop visit (own) |
| GET | `/visits` | Visits by retailer / rep / period |
| GET | `/pricing/price-lists` | Price lists with their rates |

| GET | `/inventory/balances` | On-hand and reserved per lot per location (stock keepers only) |

| POST | `/inventory/transfers` | Move pieces of a lot between locations |
| GET | `/inventory/ledger` | Append-only stock ledger |
| POST | `/inventory/lots` | Find or create a lot (variant + batch + MRP) |
